description: Minesweeper mini-game (Сапёр) in Win95 style within the terminal
steps: Add 'minesweeper' to the terminalApp state union type in EditorApp.tsx.

Implement a Minesweeper game component inline in EditorApp.tsx (or as a separate component imported into it). Classic Win95 style: 9x9 grid with 10 mines. State: grid cells (revealed/hidden/flagged), mine positions, numbers. Left click reveals, right click flags. Game over on mine click. Win on all non-mine cells revealed.

Style the Minesweeper with Win95 aesthetics: sunken cells (border-t-gray-700 border-l-gray-700 border-b-white border-r-white for revealed), raised cells for unrevealed, number colors (1=blue, 2=green, 3=red, 4=darkblue, 5=darkred, 6=teal, 7=black, 8=gray), mine emoji on game over, flag emoji for flagged cells.
Add a header bar above the grid with: mine counter (remaining mines minus flags), a smiley face button (resets game), and a timer counting seconds since first click.
Wrap in a Win95 window with title bar 'Сапёр' and close button. Add desktop icon (bomb emoji) and start menu entry.
Add event log entry when game is won: 'Сапёр: Победа! (Охранник)' and when lost: 'Сапёр: Проигрыш (Охранник)'.
acceptance_criteria: Minesweeper opens from desktop icon or start menu in a Win95 window
9x9 grid with 10 mines, cells can be revealed by click and flagged by right-click
Numbers show correctly indicating adjacent mines with proper colors
Game over when clicking a mine (all mines revealed)
Win condition when all non-mine cells are revealed
npm run build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/JailBreak-v0-9/JailBreak-1.2 && npm run build' and confirm it succeeds
findings: Implementation complete. Created separate Minesweeper.tsx component with full game logic (9x9 grid, 10 mines, flood-fill reveal, flagging). Mines placed on first click to avoid instant death. Timer starts on first click, stops on win/loss. Win95 styling with raised/sunken borders, digital counter displays, smiley button. Number colors match classic Minesweeper. Added 'minesweeper' to terminalApp union type and handleStartMenuApp. Added desktop icon and start menu entry. Event log integration on win/lose. Build passes cleanly.
